args.title: Summary: Corvid warehouse automation posts (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.corvid.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in warehouse pick rates in 2026.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, tempering the rollout's benefits.
- Per the companion piece, the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
